component: account manager default selection and getter side effects

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The patch defers replacement of a removed cached default: removal clears m_defaultAccount and its preference, and a later getter can call SetDefaultAccount over the internal account list until an eligible candidate succeeds. A configured valid default is reused. Current later code returns null when the configured account has an uninitialized server instead of choosing another. Selection checks the protocol canBeDefaultServer capability, writes the preference and notifies root flags; it does not establish transport readiness. The general mailDefaultAccountChanged observer requires both old and new handles, so do not infer an identical direct old-to-new notification after clearing the cache. The changed unit assertion covers stale default after duplicate cleanup, not all explicit-removal/observer cases, and lacks its required assertion message. No account or test run occurred; primary discussion remains gapped.
title: Default-account lookup can select a viable account after removal or a stale preference
